meta.name: Gensou Suikoden
meta.description:
Two young boys... the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom - a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region.

The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return.

Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war.

The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.

videos.title: Hometown
videos.overview: Riliu and Jowy, two young soldiers from the Highland Kingdom, come under attack at night while on an expedition in the mountains. While fleeing, they jump into a waterfall and are swept away separately, each ending up in the territory of the States Army — their enemy. After reuniting, the two set out for their hometown.

videos.title: Mad Prince Luca
videos.overview: The Highland Army, led by Luca Blight, begins its advance toward the Mercenary Fortress where Riliu and friends have taken refuge. Riliu and Jowy are determined to fight. After burning down Toto Village, Luca finally reaches the Mercenary Fortress, where a fierce battle ensues.

videos.title: The Runes
videos.overview: Riliu and friends escape the Mercenary Fortress and set out for Muse. Spending the night at a shrine, Riliu and Jowy encounter a mysterious light. They relive memories from the past and come to bear their respective True Runes on their right hand.

videos.title: Turning Point
videos.overview: After reuniting in Muse, Riliu and friends witness the situation in the City-States, which are far from united. When Riliu and Jowy go undercover to investigate the Highland Army camp, their identities are exposed, and Highland soldiers give chase.

videos.title: Parting Ways
videos.overview: After being captured, Jowy learns that the Highland Army is planning a night attack on Muse. Determined to stop it, he makes Luca a proposal. Jowy returns safely to Muse. Riliu, Nanami, and Pilika are overjoyed to see him, but Jowy seems troubled. Riou can't help but wonder what's bothering him. As night falls, Riliu and Nanami visit Anabelle’s office at City Hall to hear about Genkaku. But when they open the door, they encounter a gruesome sight. At the same time, the Highland Army launches its surprise attack on Muse. Amid the chaos, Riliu and the others try to break through the enemy's ranks.

videos.title: Military Strategist Shu
videos.overview: After escaping from Muse, Riliu and his companions take refuge in the ruined village of North Window. To prepare for the incoming Highland Army invasion, Apple proposes recruiting a capable strategist. They set off for the town of Radat to meet Shu, a man who studied under the same master as Apple.
